summary: Abetment of suicide conviction set aside for lack of evidence; brother-in-law not implicated in harassment; Sections 113A, 113B Evidence Act distinguished; presumption under Section 113A requires cogent evidence of cruelty; no direct or circumstantial evidence linking appellant to abetment; conviction based on conjecture; appeal allowed, conviction set aside.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; conviction and sentence set aside; bail bonds discharged.
